purpose: audit trail for bounded Dreamer B1-only research iterations
scope: local world-model feasibility only; no policy screen, confirmation, blind, or official evaluation was run
dataset_type: random-action episodes on training-excluded development geometry

iterations.training: 2 learner seeds; 1,024 uniform-random decisions; 100 replay-only updates
iterations.observations: Training replay terminal prevalence was 0.00098 and 0.00195; terminal recall was zero, prior image prediction lost to repeat-last-frame, and 5-step reward rank was poor.

iterations.treatment: Increase uniform random data to 12,288 decisions and replay-only updates to 500; other losses and B1 thresholds unchanged.
iterations.observations: Training terminal prevalence rose to approximately 0.0029, but terminal recall remained zero, image predictions still lost to the shifted-repeat baseline, and reward ranking was weak. More uniform data alone was insufficient.

iterations.treatment: Anchor half of sampled windows on a true terminal transition; retain half uniform windows.
iterations.observations: Constant-prevalence BCE improved, but terminal ranking/recall and image baseline gates still failed.

iterations.treatment: Multiply newest/full observation reconstruction loss by 256; retain terminal-anchored sampling.
iterations.observations: The larger training loss scale did not make sampled prior predictions beat trivial image baselines or resolve terminal ranking.

iterations.treatment: Lower one-step KL free-nats from 1.0 to 0.1; retain prior treatments.
iterations.observations: Raw prior/posterior KL remained low and close; terminal ranking/recall and reward ranking remained inadequate.

iterations.treatment: Add 2-5 step prior-to-future-posterior overshooting KL with a 0.1 free floor.
iterations.observations: The overshooting metric stayed at the 0.1 free floor across updates, showing that this treatment had no gradient on the observed replay.

iterations.treatment: Remove the free floor from overshooting KL only; keep one-step KL free-nats at 0.1.
iterations.observations: Overshooting loss became nonzero (roughly 1e-4 to 4e-4), but did not materially improve the frozen B1 metrics.

iterations.treatment: Replace four-frame absolute reconstruction with a newest-frame residual decoder initialized at zero.
iterations.b1: fail both seeds; image baseline conditions passed
iterations.observations: Both seeds beat shifted-repeat latest/full-stack image MSE by a very small margin; terminal recall remained zero and terminal/reward-ranking criteria failed.

iterations.treatment: Apply a fixed positive-class weight of 56 to continue BCE; all prior v8 settings retained.
iterations.observations: Positive weighting worsened terminal BCE versus the natural-prevalence constant baseline, and recall stayed zero.

model_status: No policy was trained or selected. These runs contain replay-only world-model pretraining; all B1 gates failed, so no policy screen, confirmation, or blind partition was opened.
interpretation_limits: All values are local simulator/internal-proxy evidence, not official HAIC scores.
A lower training loss is not evidence of better control or private-track generalization.
The v8 image-gate result is small and does not compensate for terminal/reward prediction failures.
Protocols v1-v8 are frozen historical records and fail current source-hash checks after code evolution.
next_gate: The current candidate remains blocked before policy training by B1. Any further iteration must use a new frozen source/protocol and training-excluded cells; do not repurpose confirmation or blind cells.
